title: Hamiltonian formulation and matrix discretization for axisymmetric magnetohydrodynamics
summary: Equations of ideal magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) play an important role in the studies of turbulence, astrophysics, and plasma physics. These equations possess remarkable geometric structures and symmetries. Indeed, they admit a geodesic formulation in the sense of Arnold, as a Lie--Poisson flow on the dual of an infinite-dimensional Lie algebra. Zeitlin's model, previously developed for MHD on the flat torus and the two-sphere, is a matrix approximation of MHD consistent with the underlying geometric structures.
